title: [vendor/pulp_riscv_dbg] Possible issue in dm_csrs.sv
body:
Reposting [OpenTitan issue 2663](//github.com/lowRISC/opentitan/issues/2663):

While running LEC on `top_earlgrey` using script `syn_yosys.sh`, [line 92 of dm_csrs.sv (see below)](https://github.com/lowRISC/opentitan/blob/master/hw/vendor/pulp_riscv_dbg/src/dm_csrs.sv#L92) causes a warning:
```systemverilog
localparam dm::dm_csr_e ProgBufEnd = dm::dm_csr_e'((dm::ProgBuf0 + {4'b0, dm::ProgBufSize}));
```
`ProgBuf0 = 8'h20` and `ProgBufSize = 5'h8`, so the sum is `8'h28`, but this constant is not an element of the `dm_csr_e` enum defined in [dm_pkg.sv](https://github.com/lowRISC/opentitan/blob/master/hw/vendor/pulp_riscv_dbg/src/dm_pkg.sv#L64-L65). So the tool reports a Warning about this. 

Suggestion: Instead of above line 92 of dm_csrs.sv, would it make sense to simply add below line between lines 64 and 65 in dm_pkg.sv?
```systemverilog
ProgBufEnd = 8'h28,
```

One more note: Is it correct that `ProgBufEnd = ProgBuf0 + ProgBufSize`, or should it rather be `ProgBufEnd = ProgBuf0 + ProgBufSize - 1`?
